title: Kyndryl Reports $3.7 Billion Fiscal Q2 Revenue, Reaffirms Outlook
summary: Kyndryl reported fiscal Q2 2027 revenue of $3.7 billion, down 1.9% year-over-year, net income of $59 million, and reaffirmed its fiscal 2027 outlook.
body_markdown:
On an adjusted basis, Kyndryl reported adjusted net income of $92 million, or $0.42 per diluted share, compared with $89 million, or $0.38 per diluted share, in the prior-year period. Adjusted pretax income was $150 million, against $123 million, and adjusted EBITDA was $699 million, against $641 million. Cash provided by operations was $172 million, compared with $147 million, while free cash flow was a use of $34 million, compared with a source of cash of $22 million in the prior year.


The company reaffirmed its outlook for fiscal 2027, which runs from April 2026 to March 2027: adjusted pretax income of $600 million to $700 million, free cash flow of $400 million to $500 million and constant-currency revenue "flat to down 2%".


## Why It Matters for KD


Chairman and Chief Executive Officer Martin Schroeter said "strong signings and continued growth in Kyndryl Consult and hyperscaler-related revenue reinforce our confidence in our fiscal 2027 outlook." According to the release, signings were $4.1 billion in the quarter and $15.5 billion over the trailing twelve months. Kyndryl Consult revenues grew 4.2% year-over-year in the quarter, and hyperscaler-related revenues of more than $550 million grew 27.2% year-over-year.
